target_customer: Online merchants in India and Southeast Asia who want to accept USDC payments and run NFT loyalty programs
problem: Merchants face high card fees, slow settlement, cross-border fees and chargebacks. BizFirst lets them accept USDC and send invoices; claims of up to 80% lower fees are the company's own.
business_model: Payments fee on crypto transactions plus loyalty tooling, per company claims
product_category: Crypto payments and Web3 loyalty for merchants

founders.name: Tanmaay K
founders.background_notes: Team previously built large-scale fintech products for SMBs in Southeast Asia and India per the YC page; no individual bios.

founders.name: S G
founders.background_notes: Listed by initials only on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Stablecoin checkout and invoicing plus NFT loyalty contracts are standard Web3 engineering; the hard parts are compliance and merchant integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Stablecoin checkout widgets were easy to copy and larger players offered similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Circle announced merchant services for USDC acceptance in 2022 with partners such as Stripe and Checkout.com; no source on what happened to Apollo.

market_need_then: A June 2022 survey cited by PYMNTS reported 77% of merchants accepting crypto did so for lower processing fees, but demand among Indian SMBs was unproven in sources found.

branding.domain_note: Uses apollofirst.xyz, a nonstandard domain, because the plain name is common.

identity.voice_and_tone: Building consumer and enterprise products for frontier markets

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared with many companies (an AI sales platform and GraphQL tool among them) and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Apollo launched BizFirst in 2022 during a crypto peak and listed YodaaX as coming soon, but no funding, customers or later news was found in searches. The crypto downturn after 2022 and crowded stablecoin checkout space are context, yet no source states what happened, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: Competitors empty: neither the YC launch post nor the site names rivals, and the dated search found no 2022 Indian or SEA competitor sources; Coinbase Commerce, BitPay appeared only in 2026 guides. A site footer lists Y Combinator and Speedinvest as backers, but no amounts, so no round recorded. The CB Insights Apollo profile with $130K describes a different company. Brand effect left unclear because no customer evidence on the name collision exists. Outcome not found: no shutdown, pivot or acquisition news.
